prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 40s silver fox goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, silver-white half-up hair, top section lifted with the length flowing loose below — full body bamboo forest irezumi covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle, both legs FULLY covered to ankles. Bold black ink outlines — BLAZING DEEP EMERALD bamboo stalks wrapping the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID JADE leaf clusters filling every gap, every mark crisp and hand-made with clean defined edges. A small smudge of soot touches her temple and jaw, with light grime on her fingers and the tops of her bare feet. Her expression is a composed expression with a faint weariness in her eyes. Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto a massive square-cut rough-hewn oak timber beam mortised into two square oak posts that stand on either side of her, at a height just above her raised hands, the cuffs sitting snug against the metal, her wrists a little wider apart than her shoulders and her arms raised straight up. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto a second square oak timber mortised into the same two posts at ankle height, the cuffs sitting snug against the metal, her feet spread about shoulder-width apart. Pose: standing full height between the supports, facing the camera, her arms raised straight up with her hands hanging limp and loose from the cuffs, fingers softly curled and relaxed, her head tipped very slightly forward, her bare feet spread about shoulder-width apart flat on the flagstones, her whole body sagging a little with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes. extra long coffin chrome nails emerald silver tips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her from one side. A single woman fills the frame. Pattern density MAXIMUM — the pattern wraps her entire body from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
